text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sapporo Kinen. At the 
airport is "a certain heavyweight 
contender"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "Empress" Air Groove was there as 
well. Her passionate feelings showed as 
she said, "You're going to entertain me, 
aren't you?"...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion wondered if she could pull off 
some kind of surprise for Air Groove. Like 
running from the back as a "Chaser"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It all depends on how she finishes her 
preparations, but she smiles. "Even if I 
just run normally, I'm sure I'd be 
shockingly strong, after all."
